title: BacklogValuesMeasuredPayload
description: Payload of the BacklogValuesMeasured event (INV-REQ-1370; class: domain). Delivery is at least once. No value is a metric label (Prometheus instrumentation guidance on label cardinality): entity and period are payload fields. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

periodRef.description: The prescribed accounting period reference, e.g. 2026Q1.

queueDepth.description: Number of versions waiting to be sent.

oldestUnsentAgeSeconds.description: Age in seconds of the oldest unsent version; absent when no version is unsent.

failureRate.description: Share of completed attempts that failed; 0 when there is no completed attempt.

unacknowledgedCount.description: Submissions sent and not yet acknowledged.

measuredAt.description: The instant the values were measured.
